page_title: UNI 1-5 BAY | Union Berlin v Bayern Munich 20/04/2024, Stats - Flashscore.com | Match

commentary.text: 90+3' The referee checks his watch and blows his whistle to signal the end of this match.
90+2' Brenden Aaronson (Union Berlin) attempts to send a low pass into the box from the edge of the penalty area, but the opposition's defence knocks the ball to safety.
90+1' 1 - 5 Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) scores a lucky goal from mid-range. Although his low shot was struck towards the middle of the goal, the goalkeeper was unable to reach the ball.
90' 2 additional min. will be played.
88' The referee points to the corner flag and Union Berlin will take a corner.
88' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) sends over a cross from the side into the penalty area in order to find one of his teammates, but he fails and the opportunity goes begging.

86' A pass travels right across the box to Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) and gives him a sight of goal. He tries to beat the keeper low in the middle of the goal, but Manuel Neuer denies him with a decent save.
86' Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) gathers a pass, skips past an opponent and lets fly from mid-range. His effort, however, is well wide of the right post.
85' 40:60 – the latest ball possession ratio.
84' The referee signals a substitution. Lovro Zvonarek (Bayern Munich) is brought on as a substitute for Thomas Muller.
83' Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) attempts to scoop the ball into the box over the defence, but one of the defending players makes a timely intervention.
82' The attendance for today's match is 22012.
81' Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) sends a weak shot high over the bar from the edge of the box.
78' Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich) hits a shot towards the bottom left corner from the edge of the box, but it's a weak attempt and is easily saved by Frederik Ronnow.
77' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) sends the ball into the box from the side of the pitch, but his cross is blocked.
75' Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin) receives a neat pass inside the box with his back to goal, swivels and hits a powerful shot that goes narrowly over the crossbar.
73' A good clearance by a defender means the corner comes to nothing for Bayern Munich.
72' Great save! Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) had time and space inside the box after picking up a neat pass, but his shot towards the right side of the goal was brilliantly saved by Frederik Ronnow.
71' The manager has decided to make a substitution and Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting walks off the pitch to be replaced by Bryan Zaragoza (Bayern Munich).
71' The substitution has been made. Konrad Laimer (Bayern Munich) has replaced Leon Goretzka.
70' Thomas Tuchel prepares a substitution. Joshua Kimmich is replaced by Noussair Mazraoui (Bayern Munich).
70' Substitution. Kevin Volland walks off the pitch and Robin Knoche (Union Berlin) comes on as a substitute.
69' Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) latches onto a loose ball inside the box but slams it just over the bar.
69' Bayern Munich are bossing possession at the moment by exchanging some precise passes from player to player.

66' 0 - 5 It's in the back of the net! Leon Goretzka sends a superb cross into the box. Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) latches on to it and from near the penalty spot powers a header low inside the right post, leaving Frederik Ronnow beaten. He displayed his eye for goal there - excellent finish. The score is 0:5.
65' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) tries to find Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen, but he puts too much power on the through ball.
64' Bayern Munich will have a chance to score from a corner kick.
62' 0 - 4 Goal! Harry Kane produces a great pass that finds Mathys Tel (Bayern Munich) inside the penalty area, who takes advantage of the situation to rifle a shot into the bottom left corner. 0:4.
59' That will be all from Christopher Trimmel who is being replaced by the fresh legs of Josip Juranovic (Union Berlin).
59' We are about to witness a subsitution. Mikkel Kaufmann Sorensen (Union Berlin) for Diogo Leite.
59' The referee signals that it is time for a substitution and Aissa Laidouni (Union Berlin) is coming onto the pitch as Andras Schafer cannot continue after picking up an injury.
59' Here is a change. Benedict Hollerbach is going off and Nenad Bjelica gives the last tactical orders to Yorbe Vertessen (Union Berlin).
59' Substitution. Min-Jae Kim will be replaced by Dayot Upamecano (Bayern Munich).
56' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) sends a chip pass into the box, but Frederik Ronnow is quickest to intercept the ball.
55' One of the defenders is in the right place at the right time and makes a vital stop to deny a close-range header from Robin Gosens (Union Berlin).

53' 0 - 3 It's a goal! Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) scores with a brilliant shot into the top right corner after being released inside the box by a superb lofted pass from Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting. The score is now 0:3.
52' Total attempts – 7:9.
48' Bayern Munich control the tempo of the game by exchanging some accurate short passes.
46' Everything is set for the start of the second half.
45+3' The referee blows his whistle for half-time, bringing to a close the first 45 minutes of the match.
45+1' Nenad Bjelica appears to have said too much and referee Sven Jablonski comes over and theatrically shows him a yellow card.
45+1' 0 - 2 Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) scores a great goal from the resulting free kick from mid-range. He sends the ball directly inside the right post.
45' There will be a minimum of 2 min. of added time.
45' Bayern Munich are awarded a free kick on the edge of the box.
45' Sven Jablonski interrupts the game. One of the players from Union Berlin won the ball, but his effort is adjudged unfair.
43' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) leaps high to meet a lofted pass inside the six-yard box, but his header flies yards over the crossbar.
42' Union Berlin have a chance to score from a corner kick, but the ball is cleared by a defender.

42' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) gets on the end of a pass inside the box and produces a promising first-time shot towards the bottom right corner. His effort is blocked by Manuel Neuer with a brilliant diving save!
41' The linesman raises his flag. Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) is adjudged offside.
40' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) is flagged for offside.
35' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) goes over to take the corner kick and it looks like he will send the ball into the penalty box.
34' Danilho Doekhi (Union Berlin) towers above the defence but fails to trouble the keeper, heading the corner kick well wide of the left post from close range.
34' Union Berlin force a corner. They send men into the box.
33' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) had a good opportunity from long range. His shot was directed towards the left side of the goal, but Manuel Neuer was alert and made a comfortable save.
33' The possession of the ball – 42:58.
29' 0 - 1 After receiving a beautiful pass, Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) had a huge opportunity. He coolly unleashed a perfect shot, which went in off the crossbar.
28' Leon Goretzka (Bayern Munich) leaps highest in the middle of the box to meet a lofted ball and powers a header at a goal, but unfortunately for him it flies just over the bar.
24' Robin Gosens (Union Berlin) had a good opportunity when he latched on to a cross from the wing, but his header wasn't accurate at all and the ball went well over the bar.
23' Alphonso Davies (Bayern Munich) sends a pass into the box, but his attempt is thwarted and cleared.
22' 1:5 – this is the total number of shots produced by both teams.
20' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) collects a sweet pass on the edge of the box and in one movement smashes a shot in on goal, but it balloons high over the bar.
19' Benedict Hollerbach (Union Berlin) sends a pass into the penalty area, but the opponent manages to cut it out.
18' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) flashes a header well wide of the left post following a lofted pass into the centre of the box.
18' The Bayern Munich players are exchanging some short passes to try and open up the opposition’s defence and hit them swiftly on the break.
13' Joshua Kimmich (Bayern Munich) swings a cross into the box, but it's far too close to Frederik Ronnow, who smothers the ball.
13' Kevin Volland (Union Berlin) swings in a dangerous cross from the resulting corner kick, but none of his teammates manage to outjump the defence.

12' Lucas Tousart (Union Berlin) finds himself in a promising position after receiving a precise pass. He pulls the trigger but only hits one of the opposition, who gets in the way of his effort. The referee points to the corner flag. It's a corner to Union Berlin.
12' The resulting corner, taken by Kevin Volland (Union Berlin), comes to nothing.
10' Min-Jae Kim (Bayern Munich) pulls the jersey of one of the opposition players and Sven Jablonski blows his whistle for a foul.
9' Eric Maxim Choupo-Moting (Bayern Munich) strikes a shot towards goal from the edge of the penalty box, but it flies just wide of the left post.
6' Thomas Muller (Bayern Munich) latches onto a cross but somehow sends his close-range header high over the bar.

5' Harry Kane (Bayern Munich) blows a good opportunity. He has a lot of space around him and fires a terrific shot from the edge of the box towards the middle of the goal, but the goalkeeper makes a brilliant save and stops this one!
5' A cross from a mid-range free kick, taken by Bayern Munich, is intercepted by one of the defenders.
1' Christopher Trimmel (Union Berlin) clips an inviting cross into the box, but there's no one in a position to get on the end of it.
1' The match has just started.
The players are on the pitch and Bayern Munich will have the kick-off.
Sven Jablonski will referee today's match.
